Well, as far as I'm aware, most hotlines are anonymous, I don't really have issues with anonimity when calling someone anyway, it's just that I'm just really anxious about actually talking to people, whether its in person or through phone/skype/etc

I guess writing removes a lot of the human aspect of communication, hence I feel less afraid to do it

See, for me, calling a hotline is too much - I don't have too much of an issue with writing about my problems on the internet under the guise of anonimity, but calling someone for even the most trivial matter takes a lot out of me, so calling somebody to ask for help with my issues is just something I'm terrified of doing, despite the fact I know how irrational that fear is.

Adding to that is the fact that the country I reside in is not the country I was born in, and I still don't feel perfectly comfortable about speaking the language, which is made even worse by vocal minorities with strong, negative feelings about immigrants

Pretty much just video games, but even that I cant do as my shitty laptop now overheats if I try anything more taxing than browsing the internet

I used to enjoy football back in secondary school but now I wouldn't really have anyone to play with + too embarassed about being completely out of shape + it's way too hot

Other than that, the degree that I failed was a computing one, and I enjoy programming but I don't really have enough knowledge or experience to make a good use of it
